body.x: “INADA Family”, a massage chair brand, showcased its “SOGNO (STMC-7100)”, a bestseller model, and the “3S (STMC-7600)”, a medical chair for perfect posture, at “CES (Consumer Technology Show) 2016”, the world’s largest IT devices and tech exhibition, which ran for four days from Wednesday the 6th to Saturday the 9th in Las Vegas.Founded in 1962, the company has researched, developed, and manufactured massage chairs for half a century. It is a “MADE IN JAPAN” brand, and based on high workmanship and innovative technology, it is popular in more than 70 countries, including those in Asia, North America, and Europe.The massage chair “SOGNO” adopts the air pressure massage system, instead of the rolling massage system. It is a top-class product, like first class on an airplane, which can give an ideal massage, similar to that of hand massages.

Furthermore, it is capable of providing soft massages, as the company reduced excessive pressure and discomfort by dispersing pressure into four points, allowing for pleasant massages on acupressure points on the head, shoulders, and waist.In addition, to provide the best massage experience, the company differentiates the product from existing ones by using the Ultra-Slow System, which can freely control speed, intensity, and rotation -- even while it is massaging the user’s muscles.“SOGNO”, a result of the INADA Family’s “design management”, is suitable for unique and luxurious interior designs. In particular, users can find Kita Toshiyuki’s atmosphere -- a representative Japanese product and furniture designer -- from the product.“3S” is a medical massage chair that has its own stretching function for supporting straight postures. By using the function, it not only stretches one’s body but also makes it flexible to be stretched by capturing the natural "S" curves of one’s spine, all from a masseuse's point of view.

It is not like ordinary massage chairs that provide simple functions, such as massages and tapping. With its upgraded stretching function, it makes one’s body straight and corrects fundamental postures.Moreover, this product specializes in correcting bad postures, which are problematic for modern society, and managing female body shapes. By using the "S-retching" function, it softens women's stomach and lymph glands near the breast. This model enables users to kill two birds with one stone -- health and beauty.INADA Family products are distributed in the domestic market by CARE IN (CEO Jo Jun-seok).“CES”, which is held every year in January by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), is the world’s largest IT consumer electronics exhibition, showcasing global trends in the electronics and IT industry. AVING News, which has sent reporters to CES for 11 years, will introduce various up-to-date technologies and products showcased at CES 2016.
